images.title: Each square becomes 8 squares
images.purpose: Shows the rule that every remaining square of the carpet turns into 8 remaining squares, so the count is multiplied by 8 at every step.
images.composition: Plain white background with generous empty margins; the main object is large and centred and fills about 60 percent of the frame; nothing else is drawn. Top row: one square, an arrow, the same square split 3 by 3. Bottom row: the counts 1, 8, 64, 512 in a line with a small curved arrow between neighbours.
images.exact_structure: Top row, centred: Square A, one solid square filled teal #0072B2. A thick grey arrow pointing right with the label '× 8' above it in reddish purple #CC79A7. Square B, the same size as A, split by thin dark lines into a 3 by 3 grid of 9 equal cells: the 8 outer cells are teal and the 1 centre cell is white with a thin dark outline (a hole). Bottom row, centred under the top row, with wide gaps: four large bold amber #E69F00 numbers '1', '8', '64', '512' from left to right. Between each pair of neighbours a small curved grey arrow arches over the gap from left to right, with '× 8' in reddish purple above it: 3 such arrows. So '× 8' appears 4 times in total (1 in the top row, 3 in the bottom row). Under the '512' in small grey text: 'Step 3'. Nothing else.
rejection: any count of objects, cells, ticks or rows that differs from the numbers stated in the spec
any text beyond the listed visible text, or any listed text misspelled or altered
any board name, publisher name, book title, page number or curriculum branding anywhere in the frame
a hyphen used in place of a minus sign on any labelled number
images.takeaway: Each square becomes 8 squares, so the count is multiplied by 8: 1, 8, 64, 512.
images.description: Shows the rule that every remaining square of the carpet turns into 8 remaining squares, so the count is multiplied by 8 at every step.
images.context: Concept T2.C2; one image that shows only the main idea.

image_decisions.why: The concept is a multiplying rule; seeing one square turn into 8 and the chain 1, 8, 64, 512 is the whole idea.
